title: Assistant Professor of Philosophy, Tenure-Track, August 2027
description:
Description

Chapman University invites applications for a tenure-track position
at the rank of Assistant Professor in Philosophy, beginning August
1, 2027. The appointment will be housed in the Philosophy
Department within Schmid College of Science and Technology. The
successful candidate will also have an affiliation with the Smith
Institute for Political Economy and Philosophy and contribute to
its teaching.

Successful candidates are expected to conduct independent and
original research at the highest academic level, provide excellent
teaching, and demonstrate academic leadership. Since the candidate
will be jointly affiliated with the Smith Institute, we seek
candidates interested in working together with people from
different disciplinary backgrounds. In particular, candidates
should demonstrate an interest in putting their lines of
philosophical inquiry into conversation with insights from
economics or the other social sciences and humanities.

Chapman University is a nationally-ranked institution offering
traditional undergraduate and graduate programs in the heart of
Orange County, one of Southern California’s most diverse and
vibrant regions. The University achieved R2 status in the Carnegie
Classification of Institutions of Higher Education, a distinction
held by just 10 percent of all U.S. universities and is ranked as
#110 among Best National Universities by US News and World Report
(2026). Our faculty include academic leaders who excel in research,
publishing, and world-class teaching in our 11 schools and
colleges, including the Schmid College of Science and Technology.
Dedicated to forward-looking, personalized education, we create an
environment for unlimited achievement by both our students and
faculty. More information about Chapman University is available at
www.chapman.edu .

The mission of the Smith Institute is to reintegrate the study of
the humanities and economics in the spirit of Adam Smith, the
author of The Theory of Moral Sentiments and An
Inquiry into the Nature and Causes of the Wealth of Nations,
and to recombine research and undergraduate education as a
discovery process in the spirit of Vernon Smith, a founder of
experimental economics.

Tenure-track faculty are expected to develop and maintain an active
research agenda for future tenure consideration and are evaluated
on their research/scholarly activity, teaching, and service.

Qualifications

Required:

PhD in Philosophy or its equivalent from an accredited
institution.
Strong potential for impactful scholarly contributions in the
field of Philosophy, or a closely related field.
Commitment to teaching and mentoring.
A desire to work in an interdisciplinary environment.

Preferred:

Prior teaching experience in undergraduate Philosophy (or
closely related field) and PPE courses.
Specialty in one or more of the following: Political
Philosophy, PPE (Philosophy, Politics and Economics), and the
History of Political and Economic Thought.

Application Instructions

Interested and qualified candidates should submit the following via
Interfolio:

Cover Letter
CV
Research Statement
Teaching Statement
Writing Sample
Three Confidential Letters of Recommendation

Inquiries may be directed to Bas van der Vossen, Search Committee
Chair, at schmidcollege@chapman.edu. Please use “Philosophy Faculty
Position” as the email subject line. Application review will begin
November 2, 2026 and will continue until the position is filled.
Successful completion of a background check is required for the
final candidate. The salary range for the position is $85,000 -
$98,000 per year. Position is contingent on final budget
approval.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement
